title: Present simple vs continuous + adverbs of frequency
title_it: Present simple vs continuous + avverbi di frequenza
goal: Choose between present simple and continuous and place adverbs of frequency correctly.
goal_it: Scegliere tra present simple e continuous e collocare correttamente gli avverbi di frequenza.

steps.title: Present simple or present continuous?
en: We use the present simple for habits, routines and facts. We use the present continuous for actions happening now or around now.
Present simple: every day, on Mondays, at the weekend. Present continuous: now, at the moment, today, this week.
it: Usiamo il present simple per abitudini, routine e fatti. Usiamo il present continuous per azioni che avvengono adesso o in questo periodo.
Present simple: every day, on Mondays, at the weekend. Present continuous: now, at the moment, today, this week.

head: Present simple
Present continuous
rows: I am working / she is working

examples.en: She works in a bank, but she's on holiday this week.
examples.it: Lavora in banca, ma questa settimana è in vacanza.

steps.title: Adverbs of frequency
en: Adverbs of frequency say how often something happens. They usually go before the main verb, but after the verb to be.
Use How often ...? to ask the question. We use them with the present simple.
it: Gli avverbi di frequenza dicono quanto spesso accade qualcosa. Di solito vanno prima del verbo principale, ma dopo il verbo to be.
Per chiedere si usa How often ...? Si usano con il present simple.

head: Adverb
Meaning
Example
rows: We often go out on Friday.
I hardly ever eat fast food.

examples.en: How often do you visit your grandparents?
examples.it: Quanto spesso vai a trovare i nonni?

steps.title: Stative verbs and mixed sentences
steps.title_it: Verbi di stato e frasi miste
en: Verbs like like, love, want, need, know, understand and believe describe states, so we use them in the present simple, even with now.
Many sentences use both tenses: the present simple for the usual routine, and the present continuous for what is different today.
it: Verbi come like, love, want, need, know, understand e believe descrivono stati, quindi si usano al present simple, anche con now.
Molte frasi usano entrambi i tempi: il present simple per la routine abituale e il present continuous per ciò che oggi è diverso.

examples.en: I like this song. I don't like the video.
examples.it: Mi piace questa canzone. Non mi piace il video.

examples.en: Anna usually takes the bus, but today she is walking.
examples.it: Anna di solito prende l'autobus, ma oggi va a piedi.

steps.q: I ___ to work by bus every day.
steps.q_it: Vado al lavoro in autobus ogni giorno.
steps.why: Every day shows a routine, so we use the present simple: go.
steps.why_it: Every day indica una routine, quindi si usa il present simple: go.

steps.why: Look! shows something happening now: is raining.
steps.why_it: Look! indica qualcosa che accade adesso: is raining.

options: I always am tired on Monday.
I am always tired on Monday.
Always I am tired on Monday.
I am tired always on Monday.
steps.why: Adverbs of frequency go after the verb to be: am always.
steps.why_it: Gli avverbi di frequenza vanno dopo il verbo to be: am always.

steps.q: How often ___ you go to the gym?
steps.why: Go is a normal verb, so the present simple question uses do: How often do you go?
steps.why_it: Go è un verbo normale, quindi la domanda al present simple usa do: How often do you go?

steps.q: Marco usually ___ coffee, but today he ___ tea.
steps.q_it: Marco di solito beve caffè, ma oggi beve tè.
steps.why: Usually shows a habit (drinks); today shows what is different now (is drinking).
steps.why_it: Usually indica un'abitudine (drinks); today indica ciò che è diverso adesso (is drinking).

steps.q_it: Questa canzone mi piace. È bellissima!
steps.why: Like is a stative verb, so we use the present simple: like.
steps.why_it: Like è un verbo di stato, quindi si usa il present simple: like.

steps.q_it: Mia sorella non mangia mai carne.
steps.why: With she and a habit we use the present simple: eats.
steps.why_it: Con she e un'abitudine si usa il present simple: eats.

steps.q_it: Fai silenzio! Il bambino sta dormendo.
steps.why: The baby is sleeping now: is + sleeping.
steps.why_it: Il bambino sta dormendo adesso: is + sleeping.

steps.q: We ___ (not / watch) TV in the evening. We usually read.
steps.q_it: Non guardiamo la TV la sera. Di solito leggiamo.
steps.why: A routine in the negative: do not (don't) + watch.
steps.why_it: Una routine al negativo: do not (don't) + watch.

answers: She never drinks coffee in the evening
steps.why: The adverb never goes before the main verb: never drinks.
steps.why_it: L'avverbio never va prima del verbo principale: never drinks.

answers: Are they watching a film at the moment
steps.why: Question in the continuous: Are + subject + verb with -ing.
steps.why_it: Domanda al continuous: Are + soggetto + verbo con -ing.

steps.why: Understand is a stative verb: present simple negative, doesn't understand.
steps.why_it: Understand è un verbo di stato: negativo del present simple, doesn't understand.

answers: He often plays football with his friends
steps.why: Often goes before the main verb: often plays.
steps.why_it: Often va prima del verbo principale: often plays.

steps.q: Julia ___ (have) a shower now, so she can't answer the phone.
steps.q_it: Julia sta facendo la doccia adesso, quindi non può rispondere.
steps.why: Here have a shower is an action happening now: is having.
steps.why_it: Qui have a shower è un'azione in corso: is having.

steps.q: Tom is usually very quiet, but today he ___ a lot.
steps.q_it: Tom di solito è molto silenzioso, ma oggi parla molto.
steps.why: But today shows a difference from the usual: is talking.
steps.why_it: But today indica una differenza rispetto al solito: is talking.

answers: Do you often go to the cinema at the weekend
At the weekend do you often go to the cinema
steps.why: Do + you + adverb + base verb. The time phrase can also come first.
steps.why_it: Do + you + avverbio + verbo base. L'espressione di tempo può anche stare all'inizio.

steps.why: Know is a stative verb, so we use the present simple: I know.
steps.why_it: Know è un verbo di stato, quindi si usa il present simple: I know.

cards.ex: I usually get up at seven.
We often eat out at the weekend.
They hardly ever go to the cinema.
I never drink coffee at night.
How often do you call your mum?
